scope: Web API StorageManager persist 权限规范与行为
content: The persist() method of the StorageManager interface requests permission to use persistent storage, and returns a Promise that resolves to true if permission is granted and bucket mode is persistent, and false otherwise. The browser may or may not honor the request, depending on browser-specific rules. Secure context: This feature is available only in secure contexts (HTTPS).
conclusion: StorageManager.persist() 需在 Secure Context (HTTPS/localhost) 下运行，返回 Promise<boolean> 表示浏览器是否授权存储桶持久化，未获授权时数据可能在存储压力下被 UA 自动驱逐。
